title: Software Engineer - C# / C++ - Oxfordshire
description:
Software Engineer - C# / C++ - Advanced Engineering - Oxfordshire


(Tech stack: Software Engineer, C#, C++, Python, Full Stack, Vue.js, TypeScript, Django, AWS, Kubernetes, CFD, FEA, Aerothermal, Aeromechanical, Programmer, Developer, Software Engineer)


Our client is an ambitious technology company bringing together software, materials science and advanced manufacturing to develop the next generation of metal components. With international operations and substantial investment behind them, they are seeking a talented Software Engineer to help build a platform supporting innovative jet propulsion technology.


Working closely with mechanical and aerothermal engineers, you will develop software that connects engineering simulation tools, automates design workflows and helps explore new microturbine engine designs. This is an opportunity to see your code influence the development of real physical products.


Successful Software Engineer candidates should demonstrate strong commercial experience with C# or C++, alongside Python, sound software engineering principles and a minimum 2:1 degree in engineering, science or computer science. Ideally, you will have around 2-5 years' commercial development experience.


An understanding of, or demonstrable interest in, aeromechanical or aerothermal engineering is particularly important. This could come through your degree, further study, commercial projects or personal interests. Knowledge of turbines, propulsion, fluid dynamics or mechanical simulation would be especially relevant.


Any experience with Vue.js, TypeScript, Django, AWS, Kubernetes, CFD, FEA, machine learning or agentic AI would be advantageous. You do not need experience in every technology listed.

This Software Engineer opportunity offers challenging development work, close collaboration with specialist engineers and the chance to take ownership within a growing team. The package includes equity incentives.


Location: Oxford, Oxfordshire - primarily site-based

Salary: Upto 40-65K + Good Benefits and Equity Incentives


To apply for this Software Engineer position, please send your CV to Lina Savjani at Noir.
